concept: Window Light: records.coffee by Veranda, Pali Hill. The cafe is an all-white, vinyl-lined room with giant windows, so the reel is lit by a window: a soft shaft of daylight with mullion shadows sweeps across a forest-green wall and reveals the name, a shelf of record spines rises (one is pulled out for 'by Veranda'), a hotel key tag swings in over a map dive to Pali Pathar Road, five score meters fill like record slots, a '#1 of 26 in Bandra' stamp lands, and venetian blinds close and open between scenes.

alternatives.name: Window Light
alternatives.note: recommended: daylight sweep reveal, spine shelf, key tag, venetian-blind wipe

alternatives.name: Sleeve Notes
alternatives.note: safe: each fact is a record sleeve slid out of a crate (overlaps the Mondegar vinyl idea)

alternatives.name: Check-In Desk
alternatives.note: wild: the reel is a hotel check-in: room key, ledger, bell, lobby clock

dimensions.palette: forest #0E4A33 ground, pale pink #F7C9D4, room white #F4FAF6 (user choice C). No orange, no cream. Not the palettes of Madras, Boojee, Mondegar.
dimensions.fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (display, lowercase name) + DM Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: cafe name first: records.coffee revealed by a window-light sweep in frame 1 (L051)
dimensions.transition: venetian-blind wipe: twelve slats close and open across each cut
dimensions.camera: flat poster frames with slow settles; map dive to a neighbourhood pulse
dimensions.layout: huge lowercase name left-aligned over a spine shelf; stacked meters and a rank stamp in the score scene
motion_device: record-spine shelf rise with one pulled spine
dimensions.texture: soft radial forest gradients, flat pink and white shapes, 3D map for the city only
dimensions.sound: window whoosh, spine ticks, blind slat ticks, key-tag clinks, stamp thud, calm pad; voice at most 1.8 words per second; no pouring
dimensions.ending: pale pink end card, large real Bombay Cafe Map stacked lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, records.coffee big, held 3 s

experiment.move: daylight-sweep name reveal with mullion shadows (never used)
experiment.hypothesis: A name revealed by moving window light reads as the calm, bright room the cafe is known for and holds attention through the first 2 s.
